effects.label: Tranquil Mastery
effects.text: a successful Refocus may restore a second expended Focus ability, chosen with the first

system.description:
INSIGHT UTILITY

Tradition all; Cast 10 minutes (meditative); Range touch; Targets 1 willing creature; Duration 1 hour

You align the target's magical awareness with the discipline used to restore Focus abilities. For the duration, whenever the target successfully uses Refocus, it may choose a second expended Focus ability. On a Critical result, both abilities are restored immediately. On a Success, both are restored at the beginning of the target's next turn. Partial, Failure, Fumble and Blunder are resolved normally and affect only the originally selected ability.

Automated: for 1 hour, when the target uses Refocus it is asked for a second expended Focus ability as it names the first, before the roll (B8-7). A Critical restores both now, a Success both at the beginning of its next turn; a lower result touches only the first.
